sql: SELECT course_id, student_id FROM registration WHERE grade IS NULL OR grade = ''
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM prof

SELECT T3.f_name, T3.l_name, T2.capability, T3.gpa FROM prof AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Merwyn' AND T1.last_name = 'Conkay'

SELECT T3.f_name, T3.l_name, T2.capability FROM prof AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T1.graduate_from = 'University of Washington'

SELECT T5.name, T5.credit FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN prof AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id INNER JOIN registration AS T4 ON T4.student_id = T1.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T5 ON T5.course_id = T4.course_id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female' AND T2.teachingability = (SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof WHERE gender = 'Female')
SELECT T2.capability FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.type = 'RPG' AND T1.intelligence >= 4
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM registration AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.grade = 'B' AND T2.intelligence = 3
SELECT T2.name FROM registration AS T1 INNER JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id WHERE T1.grade = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.salary = 'low' AND T2.gpa = 3.5
SELECT CAST(SUM(sat) AS REAL) / COUNT(course_id) FROM registration WHERE grade = 'B'

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name, T3.name FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN registration AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN course AS T3 ON T3.course_id = T2.course_id WHERE T1.intelligence = 5 AND T1.gpa < 3
SELECT AVG(T1.capability) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.gpa < 2.5

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name, T2.capability FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id INNER JOIN registration AS T3 ON T3.student_id = T1.student_id WHERE T3.grade IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN prof AS T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id WHERE T1.salary = 'high' AND T2.teachingability = (SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof)

SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM registration AS T1 INNER JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T3.student_id = T1.student_id WHERE T2.name = 'Statistical learning' AND T1.sat = 4 AND T3.gpa = 3.8

SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM registration AS T1 INNER JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id INNER JOIN student AS T3 ON T3.student_id = T1.student_id WHERE T2.diff = 3 AND T3.intelligence = 2

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.type = 'UG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.type = 'RPG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM RA AS T1 INNER JOIN student AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.capability < 3
